notes.title: Patch Time!
notes.content: We've updated the game, and introduced new backgrounds to prevent it from looking dull. We're also busy implementing the new Steam API so that we can add achievements, but we're running into some issues that need to be sorted out first. We've also started running events, and the first one is Double Rank Points! Stay tuned for more!
